summary:
Strategic and process-oriented leader with 11+ years of experience driving Finance, Supply
Chain, and Digital Transformations for global Fortune 500 organizations. Recognized for
delivering $1.5M+ in cost savings and double-digit efficiency gains by leveraging Lean Six
Sigma methodology. Expert in partnering with CXOs to solve critical business problems
through systematic, data-driven strategies.

bullets: Engagement Leadership: Spearheaded large-scale Finance, Procurement, and Operations transformations for Fortune 500 clients.
P2P Optimization: Implemented robust AP and P2P frameworks, boosting invoice processing efficiency and optimizing Days Payable Outstanding (DPO).
Strategic Analytics: Developed automated Power BI dashboards to enhance CFO visibility into vendor performance, PO compliance, and AP aging.
Standardization: Delivered cost efficiencies through comprehensive SOP redesign and Enterprise Process Transformation.
Global Transformation: Directed Finance Transformation across 13 geographies for a premier insurance client, realizing $921K in savings and a 19 FTE benefit.
Process Efficiency: Automated import supplier exception management, achieving a 90% improvement in operational efficiency.
Financial Impact: Led AP Disputes optimization, reducing cycle times and errors to deliver $0.5M in savings.
Leadership & Mentoring: Mentored 15+ Green Belts and led 3 high-impact Black Belt projects to foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Strategic Partnership: Partnered with Bain & Co. to transition to a Regional Supply Chain model, driving significant cost-to-serve reductions.
Operational Excellence: Built the B2B Process Excellence team and redesigned the Seller Settlement process, reducing the cycle from 6 months to 30 days.
Supply Chain Resilience: Reduced product returns by 5% in 3 months via root cause analysis and automated monitoring processes.
Project Leadership: Orchestrated the B2B Stock Liquidation process and "Next Day
Market Expansion: Managed operational metrics across 7 countries in SEAME, owning the functional Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
Customer Experience: Spearheaded the "Malaysia NPS" project and designed the "OYO Thanks Campaign," scaling it from regional to national implementation.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborated with Product and Technology teams to build features aligned with market trends and customer requirements.
Loss Mitigation: Led the "Returns & Refusals" project for South Asia (India & Sri Lanka), cutting volume and value of returns within 3 months.
Process Transparency: Established performance KPIs and service plans for O2C teams, promoting integrated NCE measures.
Innovation: Recognized for leading one of the most well-managed supply chain projects in the organization.
Performance Turnaround: Elevated Bengaluru operations to 2nd best city nationally, improving vendor management metrics from 84% to 93% within 2 months.
Workflow Design: Redesigned business operational flows at all levels (Sub-process to Task) and reduced delivery TAT from 45 to 30 minutes.
Rapid Growth: Promoted within 9 months for delivering 100% results on central projects directly with the Director.
Scale & Expansion: Managed operations across 16 cities and spearheaded national expansion into major hubs like Chennai and Hyderabad.
Leadership: Promoted twice in one year for building and managing high-performing teams and establishing benchmark promotional processes.
